release_board.conflict_policy: A conflicted member is recused and replaced by a named, recorded delegate; quorum must still be four distinct authorities.
release_board.recertification: Review on expiry, material hash/config/model/data change, incident, or drift trigger before re-release.

checklist.software: Run the structural plan, test, security, durability, and interoperability gates.
checklist.ml: Verify dataset license, split, model, calibration, baseline, uncertainty, and bounded metric evidence.
checklist.operations: Verify configuration, DR, validator, telemetry, rollback, retraining, and drift controls.
checklist.incident_command: Approve rollback decision, incident response, operator communications, and claim taxonomy.
checklist.retraining_and_drift: Freeze promotion on drift thresholds or calibration breach; retrain only on a new reviewed split and recertify.
checklist.incident_response: Quarantine affected claims, preserve audit evidence, notify the board, and rollback to the last attested revision.
checklist.rollback: Rollback is mandatory when a gate fails, an attestation is revoked, or an expiry is reached.

attestations.conflict_declaration: No signed external authority attestation is present; external conflict declarations remain pending.
attestations.rollback_decision: No promotion; retain bounded fixture-only release and rollback on invalidation.

attestations.conflict_declaration: No production authority or external custody attestation is present.
attestations.rollback_decision: No production promotion; rollback to bounded validation only.

attestations.conflict_declaration: Operator and trusted-baseline authorities are unavailable; no signed external attestation is present.
attestations.rollback_decision: No shadow promotion; machine replay remains non-actuating validation evidence.

attestations.conflict_declaration: Agency, IRB, hardware, and physical calibration authorities are unavailable; no signed external attestation is present.
attestations.rollback_decision: No field promotion; no physical deployment or life-safety actuation.
